contracts.action: Admin UI E2E job now runs Cypress through cypress-io/github-action@v7 instead of @v6
contracts.equivalent_path: No other workflow in the repository uses cypress-io/github-action, so this is the only call site.
contracts.before_after: Before and after, the step is called with install: false, browser from the matrix, wait-on http://localhost:8080 and working-directory js/apps/admin-ui, and the SPLIT* env vars feed the test split. The inputs did not change. Because install: false is set, the action's dependency-install and lockfile-detection behaviour is not used (pnpm-setup installs dependencies at line 240).
contracts.visible_effect: Only the CI result changes: the Admin UI E2E matrix jobs pass or fail, and the status-check job collects them.
contracts.failure_mode: If v7 dropped or renamed an input used here, or needs a newer runner/Node runtime than ubuntu-latest offers, the Run Cypress step fails visibly and the admin-ui-e2e jobs go red. Nothing fails silently. The action's own changelog is not in the repository, so input compatibility can only be confirmed by the PR's CI run.
contracts.open_question: Does cypress-io/github-action v7 still accept install, browser, wait-on and working-directory with the same meaning? The upstream release notes are not in this repository; a green admin-ui-e2e run on this PR would answer it.

summary: This is a Dependabot bump of cypress-io/github-action from v6 to v7, used only in the Admin UI E2E job at .github/workflows/js-ci.yml:269. The step's inputs are unchanged, and install: false means the action's dependency-install behaviour is not used. The repository can't show whether v7 still accepts these inputs, so the PR's admin-ui-e2e CI run should confirm it. No findings.
